purpose: Validate g462 preparation budget separation against the requested idle-entry and rapid-return physical test.
method: Filter exact revision and post-install verification cutoff, then match source/receiver exchangeTag. Use measured local elapsed spans; never subtract laptop clocks. Nested spans are not additive. The retained paired profiles cover a later successful interval; report earlier post-verification failures separately.

idleEntry.definition: Measured local receiver reentry gap between 5 and 10 seconds.

rapidReturn.definition: Measured receiver reentry gap below one second; this is a numeric proxy, not a user-labelled gesture.

observedHints.limit: Receipts establish a completed request, not readiness or future claim. Rolling diagnostic files are a retained window, not an exhaustive lifetime history.

g461Comparison.limit: Sequential field cohorts differ in cadence, system load and time. Smaller observed maxima and complete preparation reuse support the mechanism, but do not establish a causal speedup or reliability improvement.

stability.limit: READY is a current state, not evidence of an uninterrupted session. Five new failed source exits and one retained session_failed event prevent claiming the disconnect problem fixed. Worker diagnostics identify write-gate timeouts and authority query deadlines/capacity, not a proven common native cause or g462 regression.

nextPriority: Investigate A source boundary/heartbeat write admission and service/agent authority-query capacity, using the preserved exit stages. Keep release, authority and cleanup guarantees.

validation.pairedData: PASS: 12 unique matched pairs, all source/receiver end=ok; preparation/dispatch measurement bits present; all 12 reuse prepared input; three measured idle gaps.
validation.syntax: PASS: JSON parsing and git diff --check.
validation.runtime: Both service and input health READY in the collected snapshots.
validation.skipped: No executable source changed; rebuild, software tests and reinstall not repeated. No new deployment or public push.
